notes: Extracted 29 October 2026 from the guide at dd34861 and docs/evidence/holdingscard.md. The guide's Sources note and the evidence were checked on 21 October 2026 on 0.1.78-c7d3348 (Biscuit's main, the 19 October build); the evidence has no dbe0e02 section. Installed build: jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October). Its HoldingsCard source no longer matches the evidence's contract (it looks like #362's fixes; read from the source and its tokens, not rendered): the card sets AppearanceBrand Neutral itself (white, as in Figma); the badge is dark (Neutral) and AppearanceSystem warning alone leaves it dark (orange needs Semantic Intent System too); the footer Apply button is gold (Primary) and takes the card's modes; the footer links are purple; a card without onPress is a plain group, not a disabled button, and its footer still works; with no width in style the card fills a stretching host up to 328 px (a content-sized host still shrinks it to about 264 px, #362's 27 October re-test); a badge is held to 70% of the top row; the footer button has no width of its own and doesn't truncate; the Radio is decorative; accessibilityLabel exists. So the guide sentences these contradict are not recorded: Primary as the default look, the green badge and AppearanceSystem warning's orange, the always-blue Apply button, a card without onPress being disabled with its footer, the width that shrinks to its content anywhere else, 'The whole card is one button', and the Give it a width, Two words and A long badge pairs (their reasons). Their advice stays where the guide gives it otherwise: set the width with style, keep the action to one word, a short badge fits beside the logo. The facts' AppearanceBrand default (Primary) is the token collection's; this card overrides it to Neutral. The guide names no other component to use instead, so avoidWhen is empty (Biscuit's Storybook page points to PlanComparisonCard and SummaryTile, but the guide doesn't). The guide gives no accessibility guidance, so accessibility is empty. Examples use the guide's own content and logo and the 328 px width its sizing sets, without Color Mode and without the In context VStack's Slot gap and Padding modes; the gold holding has no onPress, which on dbe0e02 makes it a plain group (on c7d3348 it would have been a disabled button). Not recorded as gaps: the published Storybook's age and its With image logo, and the #362 items dbe0e02 fixed.

examples.purpose: Choosing a loan offer: a Title over two offer cards, each 328 px wide. The screen holds the choice: selected is true only on the offer it holds, and each card's onPress should pick that offer (the handlers here are stubs).
examples.jsx:
<VStack style={{ width: 328 }}>
  <Title title="Pick an offer" subtitle="Pre-approved for you" />
  <HoldingsCard
    headerImage={require('../assets/jio-gold-logo.png')}
    heroLabel="Loan amount up to"
    heroValue="₹1,89,000"
    details={[
      { label: 'Interest', value: '12% p.a.' },
      { label: 'Tenure', value: '36 months' },
      { label: 'Processing fee', value: '₹499' },
      { label: 'APR', value: '15.47%' },
      { label: 'EMI', value: '₹6,277/m' },
    ]}
    selected
    onPress={() => {}}
    style={{ width: 328 }}
  />
  <HoldingsCard
    headerImage={require('../assets/jio-gold-logo.png')}
    heroLabel="Loan amount up to"
    heroValue="₹2,50,000"
    details={[
      { label: 'Interest', value: '13.5% p.a.' },
      { label: 'Tenure', value: '48 months' },
      { label: 'Processing fee', value: '₹999' },
      { label: 'APR', value: '16.2%' },
      { label: 'EMI', value: '₹6,768/m' },
    ]}
    selected={false}
    onPress={() => {}}
    style={{ width: 328 }}
  />
</VStack>

from.quote: The screen lists its offers and keeps one selected: each card’s onPress picks that offer, and its selected follows the screen’s choice.

evidenceFacts.name: details
evidenceFacts.description: Left out, the card shows five sample terms. Three to a row in equal columns, 12 px apart, with rows 16 px apart; a short row is padded.

evidenceFacts.description: Term labels (10 px) wrap; term values (12 px) end in an ellipsis unless disableTruncation lets them wrap.

evidenceFacts.name: footerItems

evidenceFacts.quote: `footerItems: { label, linkLabel?, onLinkPress? }[]` (two placeholders, "Link") as label + Coin `Link`

evidenceFacts.name: modes
evidenceFacts.description: The Radio and the footer's Divider take the card's modes.

evidenceFacts.name: AppearanceBrand
evidenceFacts.description: Sets the panel's fill and stroke and the term labels' colour: Primary pale gold (#fef4e5), Secondary lilac (#f6f3ff), Neutral white with an #ebebed stroke (Figma's look), Tertiary light grey (#f5f5f5). The card's radius (16), 1 px stroke, padding (20 / 16) and gap (10) don't change with any mode.
evidenceFacts.quote: Card tokens (`holdingsCard/*`, one mode): radius 16, 1 px stroke, padding 20 / 16, gap 10
